lots.title: Refuse collection vehicles (RCV's)
lots.description: Contract hire / leasing of refuse collection vehicles (RCVs) under ESPO Framework 218_26 for the period 01 July 2026 to 30 June 2030. Internal combustion engine and alternatively fuelled options are both in scope at the Framework level. Detailed per-lot specification is referenced in the Invitation to Tender (Section 2, Requirement (Specification)) and is not reproduced in this Tender Submission Document.
requirements: Supplier must confirm compliance with all essential elements of the requirement and specification outlined in Section 2 of the Invitation to Tender.
Mandatory geographic coverage: 9 defined regions of England.
Optional geographic coverage: Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland (supplier to indicate ability to supply).
Tenderer must indicate whether it will also facilitate a leasing option alongside contract hire.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Q1 method statement — lead time management, support provisions (after-sales, warranty) and performance management measures enabling continuous improvement and innovation.
Q2 method statement — resource and capacity availability, customer identification on the framework, marketing.
Q3 method statement — standard maintenance protocol, vehicle breakdown/recovery provision, system procedures for timely services and MOTs.
Q4 method statement — provision of customer/driver/crew training, spare parts distribution network, added value provisions.
Q5 method statement — local employment and skills (including apprenticeships), support for local supply chains and SMEs, environmental schemes/policies.

lots.title: Mixed specialist vehicle fleet
lots.description: Lot 9 enables further competitive selection for a mixed specialist vehicle fleet spanning Lots 1-8. Eligibility: only Tenderers awarded to a minimum of 2 of Lots 1-8 qualify for Lot 9. Customers may use a further competitive selection process via Lot 9; awards are made by Customers to a single awarded Framework supplier.
requirements: Eligibility: Tenderer must be successfully awarded to a minimum of 2 of Lots 1-8 to be eligible for Lot 9.
Lot 9 is facilitated via a further competitive selection process only (not direct award / call-off without competition in the same way as single-lot calls).
Awards made by Customers under Lot 9 will be to a single awarded Framework supplier.
Supplier must confirm compliance with all essential elements of the requirement and specification outlined in Section 2 of the Invitation to Tender.
Mandatory geographic coverage: 9 defined regions of England.
Optional geographic coverage: Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland.

warnings.message: Document is a Tender Submission (response template) — a form for the Tenderer to complete — not the detailed Requirement/Specification. The authoritative per-lot technical specification, product requirements, technical standards, and CPV codes are held in the referenced Invitation to Tender (Section 2, Requirement (Specification)) which is a separate document. Lot titles, eligibility, method-statement weightings, and geographic coverage are reliably extracted; detailed per-lot spec content is intentionally absent from this document.

warnings.message: No CPV codes are cited inside this document. Per the skill contract, evidence for CPV codes must come from Docling-produced structure; notice-level CPV metadata was not used as substitute. Downstream consumers should populate per-lot CPV codes from the Invitation to Tender body or from notice-level metadata if that is acceptable policy.

No explicit technical standards (e.g. EN/ISO/BS references) are cited in the tender submission document. Technical standards, where they exist, will be in the Invitation to Tender specification and/or in the Price Schedule (Appendix B) line items.

The document does not contain detailed per-lot product requirements suitable for seeding product_candidates. Lot entries are categorical titles only (e.g. 'Refuse collection vehicles', 'Sweepers'). Seed generation from these titles alone would amount to guessing without evidence anchors; the skill contract forbids this. Product seeds should be generated from the Invitation to Tender specification and/or Price Schedule (Appendix B) line items.

Non-price method-statement weightings sum to 38 (12+12+8+5+1). The price weighting is not stated in this document; Section 3 defers to 'Section 5 of the Invitation to Tender, Evaluation of Tenders' for the evaluation methodology.
